name: Us Market Total Return
formula: MKT_EXCESS + matching monthly RF (percent)
methodological_breaks: Latest revised source snapshot; trailing by observation time only, not point-in-time.

name: Us Market Return 3M
formula: 100*(product(1+r/100) over last 3 consecutive months - 1)
methodological_breaks: Latest revised source snapshot; trailing by observation time only, not point-in-time.

name: Us Market Return 6M
formula: 100*(product(1+r/100) over last 6 consecutive months - 1)
methodological_breaks: Latest revised source snapshot; trailing by observation time only, not point-in-time.

name: Us Market Return 12M
formula: 100*(product(1+r/100) over last 12 consecutive months - 1)
methodological_breaks: Latest revised source snapshot; trailing by observation time only, not point-in-time.

name: Us Market Drawdown
formula: 100*(wealth / max(1, all prior and current wealth) - 1); starts July 1926
methodological_breaks: Latest revised source snapshot; trailing by observation time only, not point-in-time.

name: Us Market Max Drawdown To Date
formula: Minimum running drawdown up to current month
methodological_breaks: Latest revised source snapshot; trailing by observation time only, not point-in-time.

name: Us Market Max Drawdown 12M
formula: Worst chronological peak-to-trough loss within last 12 monthly returns, including preceding wealth level
methodological_breaks: Latest revised source snapshot; trailing by observation time only, not point-in-time.

name: Us Market Volatility 12M
formula: sample SD of last 12 monthly percent returns * sqrt(12)
methodological_breaks: Latest revised source snapshot; trailing by observation time only, not point-in-time.

name: Us Market Volatility 60M
formula: sample SD of last 60 monthly percent returns * sqrt(12)
methodological_breaks: Latest revised source snapshot; trailing by observation time only, not point-in-time.

name: Us Market Online Bear
formula: Enter bear at <=-20% from running high; exit when >=20% above bear low; no retrospective relabeling
methodological_breaks: Operational 20% hysteresis convention; not an official label; monthly closes can miss intramonth crossings.

name: Us Market Trend Regime
formula: Current wealth versus inclusive trailing 10-month mean: above +1%=bull, below -1%=bear, else consolidation
methodological_breaks: Predeclared descriptive convention; distinct from drawdown hysteresis; no threshold optimization.

name: Us Market Realized Vol
formula: 100*sqrt(252*mean(daily decimal total return squared))
methodological_breaks: Observed source trading days; official exchange calendar not independently reconstructed. FIZ/CIZ break and daily/monthly construction difference retained.

name: Us Market Downside Vol
formula: 100*sqrt(252*mean(min(daily decimal total return,0)^2)); all observed days in denominator
methodological_breaks: Observed source trading days; official exchange calendar not independently reconstructed. FIZ/CIZ break and daily/monthly construction difference retained.

name: Us Market Daily Compound Return
formula: 100*(product(1+daily total return)-1); differs from provider monthly construction
methodological_breaks: Observed source trading days; official exchange calendar not independently reconstructed. FIZ/CIZ break and daily/monthly construction difference retained.

name: Us Market Daily Count
formula: Number of daily source observations; >=15 and all valid; trading calendar completeness unverified
methodological_breaks: Observed source trading days; official exchange calendar not independently reconstructed. FIZ/CIZ break and daily/monthly construction difference retained.

name: Us Market Monthly Daily Difference
formula: Provider monthly total return minus compounded source daily total return
methodological_breaks: Latest revised source snapshot; trailing by observation time only, not point-in-time.
